page.title: AI Pronunciation Trainer
page.description: Practise English pronunciation with instant AI feedback on every word.
page.noscript: This page needs JavaScript to record and score your reading.
header.tagline: English · instant feedback on every word

rec.blocked.desktop1: Click the icon on the left of the address ({lock} or {tune}).

result.title.different: That sounds like a different sentence
result.meaning: The computer heard {percent}% of the sentence as written.
result.meaningDifferent: Most words of this sentence were not heard. Read the sentence on the card, then try again.
result.cutOff: Recording stopped at 30 s, before the end of the text, so the last words were not heard.
result.done: Nothing to practise in this sentence. Try the next one, or a harder level.
result.announceDifferent: Score {percent}%. That sounds like a different sentence.
hint.ending: It sounds like the final {sound} was left out: {heard} {arrow} {word}.
hint.endingNoSound: It sounds like the end of the word was left out: {heard} {arrow} {word}.
hint.th: It sounds like “th” was said as “{letter}”: {heard} {arrow} {word}.
hint.thUnclear: It sounds like “th” was not said clearly: {heard} {arrow} {word}.
hint.thTip: For “th”, put the tip of your tongue between your teeth.
hint.sh: It sounds like “sh” was said as “s”: {heard} {arrow} {word}.
hint.shTip: For “sh”, round your lips and push the air out.
legend.letters: bold dotted letters = sounds to fix
how.title: How it works
how.step1: Listen to the sentence. Turn on {slow} if it is too fast.
how.step2: Tap the {mic}, read the sentence aloud, then tap {stop}.
how.step3: Words marked {almost} or {needsWork} need practice. Tap a word to compare.
how.step1Wide: Listen to the sentence (Slow if you need it).
how.step2Wide: Click the microphone or press {space}, read aloud, then Stop.
how.step3Wide: Words marked {almost} or {needsWork} need practice: click one to compare.
tour.listenText: Tap {listen} to hear the sentence. Turn on {slow} if it is too fast.
tour.listenTextWide: Click {listen} to hear the sentence. Turn on {slow} if it is too fast.
tour.micText: Read the sentence aloud, then tap {stop}. You have up to 30 seconds.
tour.micTextWide: Read the sentence aloud, then click {stop} or press {space}. You have up to 30 seconds.
tour.resultText: Words marked {almost} or {needsWork} need practice; {letters} letters are the sounds to fix, like {example}. Tap a word to hear it.
tour.resultTextWide: Words marked {almost} or {needsWork} need practice; {letters} letters are the sounds to fix, like {example}. Click a word to hear it.
mic.title: Check your microphone
mic.intro: Say “hello” when the bars start to move. It takes 3 seconds and nothing is sent.

mic.allowWide: Your browser will ask to use the microphone: click {allow}.

mic.silent1: Is the microphone muted (or the switch on the headset)?
mic.silent2: Hold the phone closer, or speak a little louder.
mic.silent2Wide: Move closer to the microphone, or speak a little louder.
mic.silent3: Using a headset? Check that it is plugged in.
